criteria.statement: coverage/milestone-4.json passes unchanged, with the Milestone 4 scope picked by the table's file name: a Milestone 4 table with every requirement accounted for passes, and B19.03 and G07 stay outside it.

A table named milestone-5.json is checked against the Milestone 5 scope, so a Milestone 4 requirement in it fails with unknown-requirement. A table with a requirements section and any other name fails with unknown-scope.

In milestone-5.json an agreed difference whose text names ADR-0084 or ADR-0083 passes, and one that names neither fails with difference-without-adr. In milestone-4.json one that names only ADR-0084 fails with difference-without-adr.

A part of Milestone 5, such as B14.01/saved-plan, is placed though its parent is not listed and is closed by its planned criteria. A part that is neither a row nor in open fails with missing-requirement, a part with agreedDifference fails with difference-on-parent, and a sub-id of an unlisted parent that is not a part fails with unknown-parent.
Every agreed difference of the scope is a row or in open, and one that is neither fails with missing-agreed-difference.
A carried row retired by ADR-0084 passes in milestone-4.json and in milestone-5.json.

The first coverage/milestone-5.json passes make check-coverage with every requirement, part and agreed difference of the scope in open, a plan for 0.1 and every unit of slices 1 to 8, and no unit but 0.1.
criteria.noAutomatedProof: This criterion is about the committed table itself. make check-coverage, which CI runs on every pull request, checks it, and the reviewer checked its plan against the Coverage sections of slices 1 to 8.
